The '''Exchange Bandit''' was a kind of [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] available during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. It was an [[Color/Legends|orange]]-colored [[Lhosan Industries]] model with modifications, such as the removal of the windshield.
